cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-02 — STORY RECUT, SHIPPED V2

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: SHIPPED 8/23. VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-02-v2.mp4, 1080x1920, 30fps CFR, 35.69s, -15.0 LUFS. Built against Brooks's 8/22 Loom. Governing note: every piece of b-roll must ADVANCE THE STORY, and the static product frames are not b-roll at all. v1 was product photography with a VO on top; v2 has one woman doing one continuous thing — arrives with the bag, sets it on the desk, packs it in Charleston, lives out of it for three days, carries it to the plane. 25 keyframes generated on GPT Image 2 i2i, 18 rejected across three adversarial QA passes, 7 animated on Google Omni. VO, script, every timing, the caption cards and the PDP close are untouched.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: On a girls trip you live out of your bag,
NEW. She walks in the front door mid stride, bag hanging from her hand at her side. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Arrival. The trip just started.

BROOKS: 'a girl walking in with a bag, holding it in her hand, shot on iPhone, natural lighting, ready to post on TikTok.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: so bring one that stands open on its own.
NEW. The bag standing CLOSED and square on the desk, she moves off behind it. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
It holds itself up.

BROOKS: 'it should just be the bag standing on a desk. We shouldn't have it opened here.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: UNCHANGED. Library clip lc-travel-S04.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Plain fact.

BROOKS: 'This is good.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's fully structured, smooth leather fold-over flap,
NEW. She lifts the bag onto the desk, arms taking its weight. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Weight and structure, shown by how she handles it.

QA rated this the most reference-accurate closed-bag frame in the set.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: brass hardware,
NEW. Her hand lifting away from the handle as it settles. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Incidental detail, caught not staged.

Most reference-accurate hardware in the set. The other two variants grew a raised toggle out of the plate face.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: no logo anywhere on it,
NEW. The plain unmarked back sweeping past as she steps away. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Nothing to read on it.

The only variant that delivered the shot: plain back band, two teardrop bases, nothing else.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: so it keeps its shape packed full or half empty.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: MOVED. Library clip askme-ELEANOR-S11, the open packed bag holding its square.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Structural payoff.

BROOKS pointed at this exact clip: 'put that where it says so it keeps its shape packed full or half empty.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I took mine to Charleston in June and never actually unpacked,
NEW. Same woman, same outfit, packing on the bed in a Charleston hotel room. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
We are now inside the trip she is describing.

BROOKS: 'the same woman at the start, in a Charleston hotel packing her bag, cause we're telling a story here.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: it just sat open by the bed for three days.
NEW. Day three, over her shoulder, she draws a shirt up out of the open bag on the floor. Omni i2v.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
She never unpacked and it never mattered.

SEVEN failed attempts before this. Fixed by changing the BLOCKING, not the prompt. Flap, handles and straps deliberately out of frame.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Three days of clothes, shoes, toiletries,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: UNCHANGED. Library clip packvo-seg_01.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Concrete.

BROOKS: 'we have the bag actually being packed, that's good.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and it still goes in the overhead bin.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: UNCHANGED. Library clip lc-travel-S09.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Nothing gets checked.

BROOKS: 'and it goes to the overhead bin, that's good.'

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: four colors, three ship now / sale right now / I left the link below

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: UNCHANGED. The three live PDP screen recordings.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Close.

BROOKS: 'This is really good. Besides that, it's all good.' Black is an all-leather pre-order shipping mid September, hence 'three ship now'.
NOTES

cards.title: DELIVERED
cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-02-v2.mp4 in the Weekender video folder. 1080x1920, 30fps CFR, 35.69s, -15.0 LUFS, true peak -4.2 dBFS. Editable timeline in ChatCut as 'LIVEOUT-02 story recut'.

cards.title: THE GOVERNING NOTE
cards.text: 'Every piece of B-roll should advance the story of the concept.' A beat that could be swapped for a still without loss is not b-roll.

cards.title: CASTING HELD, ZERO DRIFT
cards.text: Reference Element vel-liveout-claire in all 25 prompts. Same woman, same oatmeal linen shirt, same jeans, every frame. One outfit throughout. The failure that killed LINEAR-01 did not happen.

cards.title: S7 — SEVEN FAILURES, THEN A BLOCKING CHANGE
cards.text: Diagnostic: as soon as the bag is OPEN and PACKED FULL with a person at close range, the model drops the handles and degrades the folded-back flap. One frame had no handles, two had one; one flap became a slab, one lost its gold plate, one split and hallucinated a second bag with a zipper; one grew a chrome rim round the mouth. Re-rolling traded one defect for another. FIX: shoot over the shoulder into the mouth so the fragile parts leave the frame. Passed first attempt. Saved as a standing rule.

cards.title: QA WAS ADVERSARIAL
cards.text: Three subagent passes at native resolution against six real 8/08 product photographs. 18 of 25 frames REJECTED. Rejects kept beside the picks so the calls are auditable.

cards.title: TWO PROMPT DEFECTS FIXED
cards.text: The gold oval plate kept growing a raised barrel or twist-bar out of its flat face; the staples kept collapsing from two parallel bars into a solid blade. Both fixed by moving that language to the FRONT of the prompt.

cards.title: WHY GENERATED, NOT REAL FOOTAGE
cards.text: The real Caroline Nutt footage is 12 talking-head clips with the BOAT TOTE in one hallway, not the Weekender, and has none of the shots asked for. The real 8/08 Weekender footage is product-only, no person.

cards.title: LAWS HELD
cards.text: Keyframes GPT Image 2 i2i on the real stills. Animation Google Omni i2v per the VO-ads-use-Omni law. No Seedance. No Ken Burns, no frozen stills — all 14 beats move. Every video item muted at -60 dB. One locked 30fps CFR, one encode pass.

cards.title: STILL OPEN
cards.text: The :30 cutdown is written in the concept doc but not built. It is a trim of this same timeline.
